per_choice_findings.original_option_text: The current policy directs the pharmacist to email a detailed explanatory statement to the Board.
per_choice_findings.finding_ko: 이메일이라는 전달방식 자체는 현행 서명 Mandatory Disclosure Form의 제출 지침으로 확인된다. 다만 Policy I는 그 양식과 상세설명을 요구한다. 이 보기를 이메일 방식의 부분 설명으로 지지하며, 양식 없는 자유서식 이메일만으로 의무를 완료했다는 뜻으로 인증하지 않는다. 원해설의 필수 양식·서명 조건 생략은 별도 MINOR_EDIT이다.

legal_review.finding_ko: CE 부족의 현행 통지 전달방식과 Mandatory Disclosure Form·서명본 조건을 구별한다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 현재Policy2021-04 I는MandatoryDisclosureForm과상세설명을요구하고PDF가공식form목록을링크한다. 현행10/6/26form은서명본·상세설명/관련서류를bhplcomplaints@mass.gov로email제출하도록한다. 따라서email자체가불법/오답은아니며키는유지한다. 다만원core/교정문이필수양식·서명조건없이statementemail만제시하여완결된통지절차로오해될수있으므로그조건을보완해야한다. 원문이‘emailonly’라고한것으로바꾸거나양식이첨부됐다고가정하지않았다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: 현재Policy2021-04 I는MandatoryDisclosureForm과상세설명을요구하고PDF가공식form목록을링크한다. 현행10/6/26form은서명본·상세설명/관련서류를bhplcomplaints@mass.gov로email제출하도록한다. 따라서email자체가불법/오답은아니며키는유지한다. 다만원core/교정문이필수양식·서명조건없이statementemail만제시하여완결된통지절차로오해될수있으므로그조건을보완해야한다. 원문이‘emailonly’라고한것으로바꾸거나양식이첨부됐다고가정하지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 이메일이라는 전달방식 자체는 현행 서명 Mandatory Disclosure Form의 제출 지침으로 확인된다. 다만 Policy I는 그 양식과 상세설명을 요구한다. 이 보기를 이메일 방식의 부분 설명으로 지지하며, 양식 없는 자유서식 이메일만으로 의무를 완료했다는 뜻으로 인증하지 않는다. 원해설의 필수 양식·서명 조건 생략은 별도 MINOR_EDIT이다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 설명이나 통지 제출이 부족한 CE를 자동으로 면제하지 않는다. Extenuating-circumstances 갱신은 Board가 결정하며 예약·통지만으로 이수한 사실이 생기지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. CE 통지 방식이 다른 mandatory disclosure를 폐지하지 않는다. 현재 CE 정책 자체도 Mandatory Disclosure Form을 요구하며 별도 사건 보고 의무도 존속한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 미래 강의 예약은 현재 미이수 시간을 이수로 바꾸지 않는다. 갱신의 완료 진술은 실제 완료 사실에 맞아야 한다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: At prescription intake, a resident pharmacy plans to close in 10 days and has not notified the Board. What timing problem exists?

choices.text: Ten days is enough when the pharmacy posts a sign immediately.
The ordinary rule calls for certified written Board notice at least 14 days before closure.
Notify the Board within 14 days after closure instead.
Use ordinary email rather than the required certified written notice.
Wait until the final prescription is transferred before announcing the date.

Case B: After notifying the Massachusetts Board about missing hours, the pharmacist assumes the deficiency has been waived without a Board decision.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

A pharmacist may attest to compliance once a future CE course has been booked.
The CE notice method does not eliminate unrelated mandatory-disclosure duties.

legal_review.finding_ko: CE 부족 설명을 보낸 사실과 Board의 waiver·갱신 결정 및 실제 이수를 구별한다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 현재Policy2021-04 I는MandatoryDisclosureForm과상세설명을요구하고PDF가공식form목록을링크한다. 현행10/6/26form은서명본·상세설명/관련서류를bhplcomplaints@mass.gov로email제출하도록한다. 따라서email자체가불법/오답은아니며키는유지한다. 다만원core/교정문이필수양식·서명조건없이statementemail만제시하여완결된통지절차로오해될수있으므로그조건을보완해야한다. 원문이‘emailonly’라고한것으로바꾸거나양식이첨부됐다고가정하지않았다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is preparing for renewal. In the first calendar year of the two-year renewal cycle, she completed 24 contact hours. In the second calendar year, she has completed 16 contact hours. Her pharmacy-law and home-study requirements are otherwise satisfied. What is the best way to address the remaining CE requirement?

choices.text: Renew now because the Board looks only at the combined 40-hour total for the two-year cycle.
Complete 4 more contact hours in the second calendar year because the 20-hour minimum applies to each calendar year.
Complete only additional pharmacy-law hours; the annual total no longer matters once the law requirement is met.
Ask the CE provider to redate 4 first-year credits so they count in the second calendar year.
Repeat all 20 second-year hours because completing more than 20 hours in the first year invalidates the surplus-year record.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist realizes before renewal that required CE hours are missing and looks for the notice method described in the currently posted CE policy.

Case B: After notifying the Massachusetts Board about missing hours, the pharmacist assumes the deficiency has been waived without a Board decision.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacist may attest to compliance once a future CE course has been booked.
Sending an explanation does not itself waive the missing CE requirement.
The CE email instruction abolishes all mandatory-disclosure requirements.
The current policy resolves missing CE by notifying the employer instead of the Board.

legal_review.finding_ko: 미래 강의 예약·자동waiver·다른보고폐지·employer 통지를 각각 판정한다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 현재Policy2021-04 I는MandatoryDisclosureForm과상세설명을요구하고PDF가공식form목록을링크한다. 현행10/6/26form은서명본·상세설명/관련서류를bhplcomplaints@mass.gov로email제출하도록한다. 따라서email자체가불법/오답은아니며키는유지한다. 다만원core/교정문이필수양식·서명조건없이statementemail만제시하여완결된통지절차로오해될수있으므로그조건을보완해야한다. 원문이‘emailonly’라고한것으로바꾸거나양식이첨부됐다고가정하지않았다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist directly oversees both sterile and complex nonsterile compounding. Which continuing-education statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Meet the applicable annual sterile-compounding CE requirement.
Use general pharmacy-law CE in place of all compounding CE.
Also assess the annual complex-nonsterile compounding CE requirement.
Apply compounding CE only to technicians.
Treat the applicable requirements as cumulative when both activities are supervised.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist realizes before renewal that required CE hours are missing and looks for the notice method described in the currently posted CE policy.

Case B: After notifying the Massachusetts Board about missing hours, the pharmacist assumes the deficiency has been waived without a Board decision.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

The current policy resolves missing CE by notifying the employer instead of the Board.
A pharmacist may attest to compliance once a future CE course has been booked.

legal_review.finding_ko: INCORRECT 극성으로 미래 CE 예약을 완료로 진술하는 해석을 고르고 통지·면제·보고를 구별한다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 현재Policy2021-04 I는MandatoryDisclosureForm과상세설명을요구하고PDF가공식form목록을링크한다. 현행10/6/26form은서명본·상세설명/관련서류를bhplcomplaints@mass.gov로email제출하도록한다. 따라서email자체가불법/오답은아니며키는유지한다. 다만원core/교정문이필수양식·서명조건없이statementemail만제시하여완결된통지절차로오해될수있으므로그조건을보완해야한다. 원문이‘emailonly’라고한것으로바꾸거나양식이첨부됐다고가정하지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 상세 설명 제출은 Board의 갱신·예외 판단과 다르며 자동 waiver가 아니다. 통지와 요건 충족·승인을 구별한다.

INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 이메일이라는 전달방식 자체는 현행 서명 Mandatory Disclosure Form의 제출 지침으로 확인된다. 다만 Policy I는 그 양식과 상세설명을 요구한다. 이 보기를 이메일 방식의 부분 설명으로 지지하며, 양식 없는 자유서식 이메일만으로 의무를 완료했다는 뜻으로 인증하지 않는다. 원해설의 필수 양식·서명 조건 생략은 별도 MINOR_EDIT이다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 미래 강의 예약은 현재 미이수 시간을 이수로 바꾸지 않는다. 갱신의 완료 진술은 실제 완료 사실에 맞아야 한다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. CE의 통지 방식은 다른 법정 보고 의무를 제거하지 않는다. 정책과 별도의 일반 보고 조항을 함께 읽었다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist was hospitalised for much of the renewal cycle and completed only part of her required continuing education. She wants to renew. What does the regulation direct her to do?

choices.text: Self-certify the shortfall on the renewal application and renew without further steps.
Renew now and complete the missing contact hours within the following calendar year.
Submit a sworn detailed statement of the extenuating circumstances for the Board to determine.
Apply for retired status until the missing contact hours can be completed.
Request that her employer certify the extenuating circumstances directly to the Board.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist realizes before renewal that required CE hours are missing and looks for the notice method described in the currently posted CE policy.

Case B: After notifying the Massachusetts Board about missing hours, the pharmacist assumes the deficiency has been waived without a Board decision.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The current policy directs the pharmacist to email a detailed explanatory statement to the Board.
Sending the explanatory email automatically waives the remaining hours.
The CE email instruction abolishes all mandatory-disclosure requirements.
A pharmacist may attest to compliance once a future CE course has been booked.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist directly oversees both sterile and complex nonsterile compounding. Which continuing-education statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Meet the applicable annual sterile-compounding CE requirement.
Use general pharmacy-law CE in place of all compounding CE.
Also assess the annual complex-nonsterile compounding CE requirement.
Apply compounding CE only to technicians.
Treat the applicable requirements as cumulative when both activities are supervised.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist only performs final verification of sterile preparations during a temporary assignment and does not physically compound them.

Case B: A pharmacist verifies complex nonsterile preparations and tries to count a general hazardous-drug course with no sterile or nonsterile compounding focus toward the specialized requirement.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

Final verification of finished sterile preparations can trigger the five-hour annual sterile CE requirement.

legal_review.finding_ko: CSP5시간·complex CNSP3시간·일반20시간 산입·과정 특정성을 구별한다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 정책의한정·업무주체·예외·기산점·의무/권고및각해설의교정문을현재공식근거에대조했다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. CSP5시간·complex CNSP3시간·일반20시간 산입·과정 특정성을 구별한다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Finished CSP의 최종 검수 및 임시 업무도 sterile CE 연5시간 trigger에 포함된다. 직접 재료를 혼합하지 않는다는 이유로 면제되지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 명시된 complex nonsterile 감독·조제·최종 검수 업무에는 매년3시간 요건이 적용된다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 적격 compounding CE는 매년 일반20시간에 산입 가능하다. 언제나20시간 위로 더해야 한다는 문장은 CDTM additional 구조와 혼동한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Sterile/nonsterile compounding에 특정하지 않은 일반 USP800 과정은 자동으로 compounding CE에 인정되지 않는다. 이는 CE 정책의 명시 기준이며 전체 USP800 문언 검증으로 주장하지 않는다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist directly oversees both sterile and complex nonsterile compounding. Which continuing-education statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Meet the applicable annual sterile-compounding CE requirement.
Use general pharmacy-law CE in place of all compounding CE.
Also assess the annual complex-nonsterile compounding CE requirement.
Apply compounding CE only to technicians.
Treat the applicable requirements as cumulative when both activities are supervised.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist only performs final verification of sterile preparations during a temporary assignment and does not physically compound them.

Case B: A pharmacist verifies complex nonsterile preparations and tries to count a general hazardous-drug course with no sterile or nonsterile compounding focus toward the specialized requirement.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist teaches the same Board-approved continuing education program four times in one year and separately completes two courses in a postgraduate pharmacy curriculum. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

She receives separate instructor credit for each of the four presentations.
Postgraduate credit is available only for courses in pharmacy law.
Postgraduate course credit requires the sponsor or co-sponsor to be Board-authorized or ACPE-accredited.
Postgraduate credit requires the course to instruct in pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacy practice or pharmacy law.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist has acceptable non-ACPE credits that do not appear in CPE Monitor and discards the course certificates after renewal.

Case B: An instructor teaches the same Board-approved CE program repeatedly in one year and requests a fresh instructor credit for every presentation.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

Renewal approval authorizes immediate disposal of all supporting CE records.

legal_review.finding_ko: 갱신 후 보존·필수 증빙정보·instructor 일회 credit·CPE 미표시 기록을 각각 판단한다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 정책의한정·업무주체·예외·기산점·의무/권고및각해설의교정문을현재공식근거에대조했다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. 갱신 후 보존·필수 증빙정보·instructor 일회 credit·CPE 미표시 기록을 각각 판단한다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 갱신 transaction 이후에도 적용되는 CE 보존 의무가 계속된다. 정책의 최근 두 full-calendar years와 규정의 완료일부터 최소2년을 같은 기산점이라고 뭉개지 않았다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 증빙은 participant·activity·provider·completion·hours 및 적용 credit details를 보여야 한다. 영수증만의 지불 사실과 다르다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 해당 Board-approved instructor는 같은 program을 가르친 credit을 연간 한 번 인정받는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. CPE Monitor에 없는 적격 credit의 증빙도 유지해야 한다. 현재 정책의 non-ACPE/IPCE 증빙 조건 및 규정의 이수증 보존·audit 제출 의무가 뒷받침한다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 갱신 후 보존·필수 증빙정보·instructor 일회 credit·CPE 미표시 기록을 각각 판단한다. 단순업무명칭대신주체·요건·허용/의무/금지를적용한다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist teaches the same Board-approved continuing education program four times in one year and separately completes two courses in a postgraduate pharmacy curriculum. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: As a Board-approved instructor she receives credit for the program taught on a one-time basis annually.
She receives separate instructor credit for each of the four presentations.
Postgraduate credit is available only for courses in pharmacy law.
Postgraduate course credit requires the sponsor or co-sponsor to be Board-authorized or ACPE-accredited.
Postgraduate credit requires the course to instruct in pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacy practice or pharmacy law.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist has acceptable non-ACPE credits that do not appear in CPE Monitor and discards the course certificates after renewal.

Case B: An instructor teaches the same Board-approved CE program repeatedly in one year and requests a fresh instructor credit for every presentation.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The stated instructor-credit route allows credit once annually for that program.
Required documentation must be retained for acceptable credits not shown in CPE Monitor.
Evidence should identify the participant, activity, provider, completion, hours, and required credit details.
Renewal approval authorizes immediate disposal of all supporting CE records.

INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. CPE Monitor에 없는 적격 credit의 증빙도 유지해야 한다. 현재 정책의 non-ACPE/IPCE 증빙 조건 및 규정의 이수증 보존·audit 제출 의무가 뒷받침한다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 증빙은 participant·activity·provider·completion·hours 및 적용 credit details를 보여야 한다. 영수증만의 지불 사실과 다르다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 갱신 승인만으로 CE 증빙을 즉시 폐기할 수 없다. 이수 후 기록 보존·Board 요청 제출 의무는 계속된다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist teaches the same Board-approved continuing education program four times in one year and separately completes two courses in a postgraduate pharmacy curriculum. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: As a Board-approved instructor she receives credit for the program taught on a one-time basis annually.
She receives separate instructor credit for each of the four presentations.
Postgraduate credit is available only for courses in pharmacy law.
Postgraduate course credit requires the sponsor or co-sponsor to be Board-authorized or ACPE-accredited.
Postgraduate credit requires the course to instruct in pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacy practice or pharmacy law.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist has acceptable non-ACPE credits that do not appear in CPE Monitor and discards the course certificates after renewal.

Case B: An instructor teaches the same Board-approved CE program repeatedly in one year and requests a fresh instructor credit for every presentation.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

Evidence should identify the participant, activity, provider, completion, hours, and required credit details.
The stated instructor-credit route allows credit once annually for that program.
Required documentation must be retained for acceptable credits not shown in CPE Monitor.

A licensed non-trainee pharmacy technician loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin using electronic validation under pharmacist supervision.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts preceptor is reviewing a candidate's internship record against the Board-approved internship requirement. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: One pathway requires at least 1500 hours, of which at least 1000 are in a Board-approved pharmacy or pharmacy-related setting.
On that pathway at least 500 hours must be in clinical pharmacy, a demonstration project, manufacturing, or analytical or industrial pharmacy.
An alternative pathway is at least 1500 intern hours acquired through experiential pharmacy education for a graduate of an ACPE-accredited institution.
The Board may grant credit for out-of-state internship experience on appropriate documentation.
All 1500 hours must be acquired within a single calendar year.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacy student begins a hospital rotation in Massachusetts without an intern license because the placement is arranged by an approved school.

Case B: An ACPE graduate has documented qualifying experiential hours and is told that all 1,500 hours must be repeated outside the degree program.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Qualifying ACPE experiential education can satisfy the specified internship pathway.
A 14-hour internship shift necessarily earns 14 hours of Board credit.
Any out-of-state employer's hour total is automatically accepted without evidence.
The Massachusetts intern license is required before the applicable internship begins, including hospital placements.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 적격 ACPE experiential pharmacy education은 명시된1500시간 대안 경로를 충족할 수 있다. 학생에게 실제 인정된 자료가 있다는 stem 전제를 지켰다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 타 주 고용주의 시간 합계가 증빙 없이 자동 인정되지 않는다. 관할권의 승인 affidavit/certificate와 Board의 인정 판단을 확인해야 한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 학교가 마련한 hospital internship이라는 이유만으로 MA intern license가 면제되지 않는다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacy student completes 12 hours of qualifying Massachusetts pharmacy-internship activity in one day. The student then remains at the site for a separate two-hour school seminar, and the preceptor proposes recording all 14 hours as Board internship credit. What should be recorded? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The preceptor should record no more than 12 qualifying internship hours for that day.
No more than 12 hours may be credited toward the pharmacy internship in one day.
The extra seminar may be documented separately as school activity, but it cannot increase that day's Board internship credit.
Combining internship work with separately documented educational activity does not raise the Board's maximum internship credit above 12 hours for that day.
All 14 hours may count as internship credit whenever the preceptor signs both the internship log and the seminar attendance record.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacy student begins a hospital rotation in Massachusetts without an intern license because the placement is arranged by an approved school.

Case B: An ACPE graduate has documented qualifying experiential hours and is told that all 1,500 hours must be repeated outside the degree program.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Qualifying ACPE experiential education can satisfy the specified internship pathway.
A 14-hour internship shift necessarily earns 14 hours of Board credit.
Any out-of-state employer's hour total is automatically accepted without evidence.
The Massachusetts intern license is required before the applicable internship begins, including hospital placements.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A PharmD graduate of an ACPE-accredited school has accepted a pharmacy residency at a Massachusetts hospital and will begin next month. She has not yet passed NAPLEX or MPJE. Which arrangement satisfies the regulation?

choices.text: She may practise on the strength of her residency appointment and PharmD degree.
She may practise unsupervised because a residency is a Board-approved training program.
She may practise only after obtaining a Massachusetts pharmacist licence.
She must hold a Massachusetts pharmacy intern licence and be supervised by a pharmacist.
She must hold an out-of-state licence recognised for reciprocity.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A PharmD graduate with an out-of-state pharmacist license begins a Massachusetts residency before the Massachusetts pharmacist license is issued.

Case B: A licensed intern withdraws from a PharmD program but does not notify the Board because the pharmacy employer already knows.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A graduate intern may perform independent final verification before pharmacist licensure.
An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.
An out-of-state pharmacist license permits independent practice during the Massachusetts residency.
Withdrawal from the program requires the stated written Board notice within 14 days.

Notice to the employer substitutes for the Board's program-withdrawal notice.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A PharmD graduate of an ACPE-accredited school has accepted a pharmacy residency at a Massachusetts hospital and will begin next month. She has not yet passed NAPLEX or MPJE. Which arrangement satisfies the regulation?

choices.text: She may practise on the strength of her residency appointment and PharmD degree.
She may practise unsupervised because a residency is a Board-approved training program.
She may practise only after obtaining a Massachusetts pharmacist licence.
She must hold a Massachusetts pharmacy intern licence and be supervised by a pharmacist.
She must hold an out-of-state licence recognised for reciprocity.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A PharmD graduate with an out-of-state pharmacist license begins a Massachusetts residency before the Massachusetts pharmacist license is issued.

Case B: A licensed intern withdraws from a PharmD program but does not notify the Board because the pharmacy employer already knows.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.
A graduate intern may perform independent final verification before pharmacist licensure.
The graduate needs the appropriate Massachusetts intern status and pharmacist supervision while awaiting pharmacist licensure.
Notice to the employer substitutes for the Board's program-withdrawal notice.

legal_review.finding_ko: Intern badge·withdrawal 통지·resident 감독·졸업 후 역할을 각각 적용한다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 정책의한정·업무주체·예외·기산점·의무/권고및각해설의교정문을현재공식근거에대조했다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. Intern badge·withdrawal 통지·resident 감독·졸업 후 역할을 각각 적용한다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 미발급 pharmacist 지위를 명찰에 표시할 수 없다. Intern name tag는 이름과 pharmacy intern을 표시한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 승인 학교/PharmD 프로그램에서 withdrawal한 intern은14일 내 Board에 서면 통지해야 한다. Preceptor나 employer 통지와 구별한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. MA pharmacist license를 기다리는 residency graduate는 적절한 MA intern status와 pharmacist supervision이 필요하다. 타 주 면허나 resident 직함 자체가 MA 독립 practice 권한을 만들지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 졸업 자체는 아직 pharmacist로 발급되지 않은 intern 역할의 제한을 제거하지 않는다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: Intern badge·withdrawal 통지·resident 감독·졸업 후 역할을 각각 적용한다. 단순업무명칭대신주체·요건·허용/의무/금지를적용한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 학생·졸업생의 상태 변경을 담당자가 업무배치 및 Board 보고에 반영한다. 실제학생/직원/약사의상태를주어진대로유지했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: A: 미발급 pharmacist 지위를 명찰에 표시할 수 없다. Intern name tag는 이름과 pharmacy intern을 표시한다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: 첫보기 “An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.”와마지막보기 “Graduation does not remove the limitations of the person's current intern role.”를포함해 실제조건·면허·인정경로·예외를판정해야한다. criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: Intern badge·withdrawal 통지·resident 감독·졸업 후 역할을 각각 적용한다. 숫자하나의존재만으로trivia라고하지않고기산점·대안경로·자격/발급·의무/권고를사례에적용하는지를확인했다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy intern withdraws from her PharmD program at the end of a semester. She plans to reapply next year and continues working shifts at the pharmacy. What does the regulation require of her?

choices.text: Nothing, because her intern licence remains valid until its expiration date.
Written notification to the Board within 14 days of the withdrawal.
Written notification to the Board within 30 days of the withdrawal.
Notification by her preceptor rather than by her.
Notification only if she does not reapply within one year.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A PharmD graduate with an out-of-state pharmacist license begins a Massachusetts residency before the Massachusetts pharmacist license is issued.

Case B: A licensed intern withdraws from a PharmD program but does not notify the Board because the pharmacy employer already knows.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.
Withdrawal from the program requires the stated written Board notice within 14 days.
The graduate needs the appropriate Massachusetts intern status and pharmacist supervision while awaiting pharmacist licensure.
Graduation does not remove the limitations of the person's current intern role.

choices.text: The applicant must be in good standing in all states where the applicant holds a licence.
A passing MPJE score of at least 75% is required.
Documentation of internship experience in accordance with 247 CMR 8.01 is required.
The applicant may be required to appear personally before the Board.
Reciprocity waives the MPJE because the applicant already passed a jurisprudence examination elsewhere.

Case B: A pharmacy uses the employer-training pathway after 500 trainee-employment hours and plans a 20-question competency examination.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist licensed by examination in another state seeks Massachusetts licensure by reciprocity. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The applicant must be in good standing in all states where the applicant holds a licence.
A passing MPJE score of at least 75% is required.
Documentation of internship experience in accordance with 247 CMR 8.01 is required.
The applicant may be required to appear personally before the Board.
Reciprocity waives the MPJE because the applicant already passed a jurisprudence examination elsewhere.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: An 18-year-old applicant passes a listed national technician examination and assumes that no Massachusetts licensing application is needed.

Case B: A pharmacy uses the employer-training pathway after 500 trainee-employment hours and plans a 20-question competency examination.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: The employer pathway requires the specified trainee employment before its examination route.
A qualifying national examination supports a licensing pathway but does not itself issue the Board license.
The specified employer competency examination requires at least 50 questions and a 75% passing standard.
The technician-examination percentage is not an MPJE raw-score passing formula.

legal_review.finding_ko: 16세 PTT 지원자의 근무 시작 전 Board-issued license를 적용한다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 정책의한정·업무주체·예외·기산점·의무/권고및각해설의교정문을현재공식근거에대조했다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. 16세 PTT 지원자의 근무 시작 전 Board-issued license를 적용한다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. PTT도 적용 업무 시작 전에 Board trainee license를 취득해야 한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 필요한 direct pharmacist supervision을 단순한 전화 연락 가능 상태로 바꿀 수 없다. 별도 hospital ADD 정책의 명시적 예외를 모든 ordinary trainee work에 전가하지 않았으며 원문은 그 예외의 업무·조건을 제시하지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 일반 ceiling은1500시간 또는1년 중 먼저 도달한 시점이다. Board extension·18세 미만·500시간 미완 등의 명시 예외는 따로 보며 stem은 adult이고 예외가 없다고 한정했다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 일반 PTT 최소연령은16세이며 full technician의18세와 다르다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A 16-year-old is hired as a pharmacy technician trainee. The supervisor asks whether training may begin before the Massachusetts trainee license is issued.

Case B: An adult trainee reaches the ordinary one-year limit before reaching 1,500 employment hours and has no applicable exception or extension.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The ordinary minimum age for the trainee category is 16.
The ordinary duration ceiling is 1,500 hours or one year, whichever comes first, subject to specified exceptions.
A trainee may work under remote telephone availability instead of the required direct supervision.
A trainee needs the Board-issued trainee license before starting the applicable work.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A 16-year-old is hired as a pharmacy technician trainee. The supervisor asks whether training may begin before the Massachusetts trainee license is issued.

Case B: An adult trainee reaches the ordinary one-year limit before reaching 1,500 employment hours and has no applicable exception or extension.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Training status permits an unlicensed start until the trainee reaches 500 hours.
The ordinary duration ceiling is 1,500 hours or one year, whichever comes first, subject to specified exceptions.
A trainee may work under remote telephone availability instead of the required direct supervision.
The trainee category uses the same 18-year minimum as full technician licensure.

A trainee needs the Board-issued trainee license before starting the applicable work.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. 변경 없는 verbal refill authorization 수신 허용에서도 PTT가 제외됨을 적용한다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Clinical dose discrepancy를 해결하는 것은 technician-tier 권한 밖이다. 전화라는 수단이나 routine이라는 판단이 임상 권한을 만들지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Offer to counsel 전달과 실제 임상 counseling은 다르다. Trainee의 offer 전달이 독립 counseling 권한이 되지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 허용된 전산 입력 보조는 전화처방을 적법하게 수신할 권한을 만들지 않는다. Typing과 prescription receiving을 구별한다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A prescriber calls with an unchanged refill authorization while the pharmacist is occupied. A technician trainee offers to receive the authorization.

Case B: A trainee is asked to telephone a prescriber and settle a dose discrepancy because the request seems routine.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Clinical dose clarification remains outside technician-tier authority.
Typing a proposed telephone order grants authority to accept it as a prescription.
A trainee who can offer counseling may independently provide the clinical counseling.
An unchanged refill may be received by a trainee because no new drug is ordered.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Clinical dose clarification·therapy modification은 technician tier가 수행할 수 없다. Pharmacist에게 넘겨야 하는 임상 업무다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 허용된 전산 입력 보조는 전화처방을 적법하게 수신할 권한을 만들지 않는다. Typing과 prescription receiving을 구별한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Offer to counsel 전달과 실제 임상 counseling은 다르다. Trainee의 offer 전달이 독립 counseling 권한이 되지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 새 약이 없는 unchanged refill이라도 PTT는 verbal authorization 수신 허용에서 제외된다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A prescriber calls with an unchanged refill authorization while the pharmacist is occupied. A technician trainee offers to receive the authorization.

Case B: A trainee is asked to telephone a prescriber and settle a dose discrepancy because the request seems routine.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

The trainee is excluded from the permitted unchanged verbal-refill authorization role.
